news.content: Started as an Undergraduate Research Intern at the Medical Imaging and Computer Vision Laboratory (MICV Lab), Yonsei University College of Computing.
Received the Honor for Academic Excellence from Yonsei University for the Spring 2026 semester.
Started leading an industry-academia collaboration between Yonsei Artificial Intelligence (YAI) and Liner AI.
Participated in the 2026 Spring Gangnam Severance Hospital - College of Engineering Joint Academic Symposium.
Korean patent published for a multimodal deep learning model for the early classification and prognosis of central nervous system inflammatory diseases.
Started as an Undergraduate Research Intern at Gangnam Severance Hospital, Dept. of Neurology.
Completed compulsory military service as an Imagery Intelligence (IMINT) Operator in the Republic of Korea Army.
Co-first author paper published in Brain Communications.
Co-authored poster presented at Pacific Symposium on Biocomputing (PSB 2025).
Completed The Medical Scientist Training Program (Undergraduate Course) at Yonsei University.
Co-authored poster presented at Korean Epilepsy Congress (KEC 2024).
Started as an Undergraduate Research Intern at the Digital Healthcare Laboratory (DHLab), Yonsei University College of Medicine.

projects.title: Industry-Academia Collaboration: Yonsei Artificial Intelligence (YAI) × Liner AI
projects.description: Leading an industry-academia collaboration between Yonsei Artificial Intelligence (YAI), a student research organization, and Liner AI, directing a student team from problem definition through deployment. Work from the collaboration has been entered in national competitions and submitted to domestic conferences, currently under review.

projects.title: Research Idea Commercialization Challenge 2026
projects.description: Team lead for 'SMART-PFN: Scalable Multimodal Analysis of Recovery Trajectories using Prior-data Fitted Networks', a clinical decision support system that quantifies daily recovery trajectories against each patient's own baseline for hospitalized patients with severe mental illness, from multimodal clinical, wearable, and behavioral data. Hosted by the Ministry of Health and Welfare, organized by the Korea Health Industry Development Institute (KHIDI), in collaboration with JNPMEDI Partners.

projects.title: AI & Public/Social Data Volunteer Action Idea Support Program 2026
projects.description: Built 'Is This Real?', an AI-powered health fact-checking service for seniors: a health claim forwarded through KakaoTalk is checked against research papers and Ministry of Food and Drug Safety public data, answered with a colour-coded verdict and its sources, with student volunteers teaching the service in person. Developed under the YAI × Liner AI collaboration.

projects.title: IBM Z × UNSA Hackathon 2026
projects.description: Built 'MARGE: ML Agents for Rule-Based Generation of Evidence', an agentic LLM workflow designed to bridge the gap between complex ML diagnostics and accessible healthcare by generating rule-based clinical evidence.
